name: Benedict Perreault
life: “I still remember an employee turning up for Saturday work in concert shoes.” People around the window at Night Shift Donuts know Benedict by a small Friday habit. Benedict knows when the going-home crowd and the coming-to-work crowd will both be there.
voice: I am the child's manager at the market. I'll hold one Saturday a month for as long as she wants it.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a brown corduroy jacket and a small enamel bird on the lapel. Benedict has one cheek that creases before the other, with a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape. Benedict holds eye contact until the other person has finished during a conversation.
personality: Benedict treats a small promise with the gravity others reserve for a contract. This makes Benedict lovely to rely on and surprisingly difficult to invite on a whim.
agenda: To protect a Saturday job for the student.
family: Pearl Gross is Benedict’s first cousin once removed. Benedict asks the question the rest of the family avoided. Pearl chooses an ordinary story to tell. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *Spin cycle choir*, Pearl says, “My hearing aids flatten the bass. I held the counter and finally felt what people meant.”
connections: Ines Baldwin (market worker). The market manager's promised Saturday post gives the pupil one reliable foothold.

reactions.situation: A relative urges the pupil to accept in public
reactions.response: Benedict lets the pupil answer privately before relatives announce an acceptance.

reactions.situation: A colleague says somebody used the wrong name in public
reactions.response: Benedict asks which name they want to hear next time and uses it in the next ordinary introduction.

reactions.situation: When offered a favor with ambiguous terms
reactions.response: Benedict says what can be returned and asks whether that will do.
